# Project Phoenix v49.5 Dynamic Historical Toponyms On-Action Hook (Zero Monthly Polling Overhead).
# Generated by gen_v495_female_toponyms_flavor.py; edit the generator, not this file.

on_location_changed_owner = {
	on_actions = {
		oe_v495_toponym_on_owner_change
	}
}

# root = location, scope:loser = previous owner, scope:winner = new owner (nullable).
oe_v495_toponym_on_owner_change = {
	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_game_rule = oe_rule_v495_toponyms_off }
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v495_toponyms_off }
		exists = scope:winner
		scope:winner = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			OR = {
				oe_v495_top_is_hellenic_roman_owner = yes
				oe_v495_top_is_chinese_dynastic_owner = yes
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		oe_v495_apply_dynamic_toponym_effect = yes
	}
}
